ev.q: Bivalent booster doses provided additional protection against COVID-19–associated emergency department/urgent care encounters and hospitalizations

bivalent booster dose recipients were compared with unvaccinated persons and with monovalent-only recipients by time since the last monovalent dose

methods_quotes.q: Odds ratios and 95% CIs were calculated using multivariable logistic regression, adjusting for age, race and ethnicity, sex, calendar day
Age, calendar day, and local circulation were modeled as natural cubic splines.
Varying time intervals between the last dose and the index date (2–4, 5–7, 8–10, or ≥11 months) were used to calculate relative VE.
Dashes indicate that estimated VE had a CI width ≥50%.
